# Mastering Spotify Advertising:  
‍**A Beginner's Guide**

When it comes to **music promotion**, Spotify Advertising emerges as a dynamic tool for artists looking to amplify their reach and connect with a wider audience. Crafting an effective **Spotify advertising campaign** is part of an holistic music promotion strategy in today's competitive landscape. Successful **marketing campaigns on Spotify** involve strategic planning and utilization of different ad formats, showcasing your music to a vast user base. 

‍

We will share some insights and information on **Spotify Advertising** and how this can be an effective strategy for **music advertising and promotion**, but we know it's overwhelming. [catapult°](https://catapultmymusic.com/) is a self-service advertising platform designed for the music industry, especially for independent artists and labels and can take care of all this for you. Try it out [here](https://catapultmymusic.com/).

![spotify running on phone](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65c699f2682d32034c354ef0/66a1454d31b68d164410fea0_1.jpeg)

For artists looking to **advertise music** on Spotify, the platform offers a unique opportunity to showcase your songs as **Spotify advertisements**. Integrating Spotify ads into your music marketing strategy allows you to engage listeners and build brand awareness in a native and seamless manner on the platform.

‍

As an artist, incorporating **Spotify Ads** for artists into your marketing strategy enables you to target specific audiences, promote your music effectively, and measure the impact of your Spotify advertising efforts. Spotify ads are made to engage, not interrupt, so listeners get a great experience and advertisers get better results. 

‍

Dentsu International recently released phase two of the [Attention Economy](https://www.dentsu.com/uk/en/our-latest-thinking/unlocking-the-new-currency-of-attention), a research project that focuses on the consumer experience of interacting with media and how it differs across digital platforms. This project introduces an innovative attention-based metric for evaluating ad performance, offering marketers valuable insights into the effectiveness of their ads across various formats, platforms, and devices. This study proved the higher efficacy of **Spotify advertising** in capturing and maintaining audience attention when compared to other platforms. Spotify’s intimate and engaging ad environment scored extremely high and is among the top-performing platforms in the study. 

‍

> **_New research from Dentsu International’s   
> Attention Economy series,   
> showed that Spotify video ads   
> drove +155% greater attentive seconds   
> compared to the platform average._** 

‍

According to Spotify, "the study showed that attention, which is measured by “effective attentive seconds” based on dwell time and outcome, was a key driver of performance across ad recall and purchase intent. That’s why in addition to driving strong performance in attention, Spotify also drove significant purchase intent uplift. That means attention isn’t just a nice-to-have — it’s the foundation for strong campaign performance".

‍

![spotify logo popping out of phone](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65c699f2682d32034c354ef0/66a1455c993539453f680631_2.jpeg)

‍

Spotify also published that "Spotify is the place to find your leaned-in, attentive audience. People stream Spotify an average 2.5 hours per day,3 which means we’re constantly learning about how people listen in real-time through our streaming intelligence — first-party, contextual data that reveals listeners’ context. That context fuels great ad experiences for our users, and for brands: 51% of Spotify Free users say they pay more attention to ads on Spotify because they are more relevant or tailored".  You can read the full study [on this link](https://www.dentsu.com/uk/en/our-latest-thinking/unlocking-the-new-currency-of-attention).

‍

#### Ads on Spotify can be effective for music advertising and promotion for several reasons:

‍

1.  Targeted Audience: Spotify has a vast user base, and the **Spotify advertising** platform allows advertisers to target specific demographics, interests, and behaviors. **Spotify ads** enable music advertisers to reach audiences who are more likely to be interested in their genre or style of music.   
    ‍

> **_Fan-targeting on Spotify advertising   
> involves tailoring your ad campaigns   
> to reach specific audiences who   
> are already fans of a particular   
> artist, genre, or music category.   
> Spotify advertising has something   
> really unique, called artist targeting;   
> with that, advertisers can specifically   
> target fans of particular artists._**

‍

![7 different background people enjoying music](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65c699f2682d32034c354ef0/66a145917c8a463a3fa09326_3.jpeg)

‍

2.  Contextual Relevance: **Spotify ad campaigns** are delivered in the context of music streaming. Users are already engaged with music, making it an opportune time to introduce them to new artists, albums, or playlists. The contextual relevance enhances the chances of capturing the audience's attention.  
    ‍
3.  Diverse Ad Formats: **Spotify advertising** offers a range of diverse ad formats, including video, audio, and podcast options. These highly engaged ad formats are a powerful way to showcase a song, album, or artist, as users experience the music in the same medium they use the platform for. A **Spotify ad campaign** can promote the video ad format for example, where advertisers can create visually engaging content to capture the attention of the audience.  
    ‍
4.  Playlist Integration: Spotify users often create and follow playlists. With **Spotify ad campaigns**, advertisers can place their ads in between songs or within playlists, providing exposure to a curated audience interested in specific music genres.  
    ‍
5.  Engagement Opportunities: Spotify ads can include interactive elements, such as clickable links or prompts for users to explore more. This engagement can lead users directly to the artist's profile, allowing for a seamless transition from the **Spotify music ad** to the music.  
    ‍
6.  Frequency Control: Advertisers can control the frequency with which their **Spotify ads** are shown to users. This ensures that the audience receives the message without feeling overwhelmed, and it allows for strategic targeting.

# How to Run Spotify Ads: Costs & Key Considerations

 [![emily-sullivan-headshot](https://tinuiti.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/emily-sullivan-headshot-150x150.png) By Emily Sullivan](https://tinuiti.com/contributors/emily-sullivan/) Feb 16 2024

**The Skinny:** _Spotify is the world’s leading audio streaming service, offering advertisers a powerful platform to reach over 600 million users through a sophisticated “freemium” model. By leveraging unique first-party data—such as listeners’ moods, activities, and real-time behaviors—brands can deliver highly relevant audio, video, and display ads across music and podcasts._

* * *

Spotify went public in 2008 in a market crowded with rival music services. The music streaming app has shattered expectations by reaching over 602 [million users](https://newsroom.spotify.com/company-info/), including 236 million subscribers, across 180 markets. It is now the world’s most popular [audio streaming](https://tinuiti.com/blog/tv-audio/audio-advertising/) subscription service.  

Spotify Ads is also the largest digital audio advertising platform — giving marketers and brands a direct line into the ears of millions of ad-supported listeners.

The breakneck velocity of Spotify’s rise is incredibly impressive. The platform’s active users spend on average 148 minutes a day listening to their favorite music app — and most of these users are enjoying Spotify’s free, ad-supported version.

It’s clear Spotify is seeing vast success, but let’s dive a bit deeper into the world of advertising within the increasingly popular platform. Here’s a quick look at what digital audio advertising is, what Spotify Ads can offer brands and advertisers, and how you can get started. It’s easier than you might think.

## Your 2026 Blueprint for TV, Audio, and Display

Learn how to measure cross-channel incremental gains and create a strategy that fuels growth and reduces waste.

[Get The Guide](https://tinuiti.com/research-insights/guides/2026-tv-audio-guide/)

 

## **The Advantages of Spotify Ads**

With a [valuation of over $72 billion](https://www.billboard.com/pro/spotify-stock-new-high-stream-on-valuation/), strong year-over-year growth in active users, with no signs of slowing down — Spotify has a bright future ahead.

Some marketers have been slow to leverage this new medium of advertising, but maybe now it’s time to pay attention as time spent in these ad units is increasing. Spotify offers marketers many unique advantages that can be leveraged to reach millions of tuned-in listeners across the globe. Let’s cover a few of the highlights:

### **Expansive a****nd Diverse Audience Reach**

Spotify is consistently expanding its reach and has an extremely diverse audience which is a huge benefit for potential advertisers. When advertising on the platform, you’ll have access to:

*   **300 million+ ad-supported listeners**
*   Users who spend **2+ hours** listening daily 
*   **A 24% lift increase** in ad recall for audio ads (according to Spotify)

As an added bonus, Spotify reports that “when compared to multi-format campaigns, audio-only campaigns tend to drive more foot traffic to stores at a more efficient cost per visit.”

In addition to effectively reaching an incredibly wide audience, Spotify also collects first-party data from its users that marketers can leverage to inform their targeting decisions.

### **Consumers Spend A lot of Time on the Platform**

Consumers are increasingly investing significant time on the Spotify platform, drawn in by its vast array of content. With almost every song imaginable available for streaming and a steadily expanding library of podcasts, there’s no shortage of entertainment options. 

With their **“Broadcast to Podcast” program**, your favorite radio shows are finding a new home, seamlessly transitioning from airwaves to headphones. The numbers speak for themselves: **32% of Americans** now listen to podcasts regularly, and that number is only growing.

### **A Ripe Opportunity for Engagement and Revenue Generation**

With a commanding presence in the audio advertising arena, Spotify boasts a substantial market share, leveraging its vast user base comprising predominantly Millennials and [Gen Z](https://tinuiti.com/blog/ecommerce/gen-z-trends/), but also attracting a significant number of older users. Currently, over [317 million users](https://ads.spotify.com/en-US/news-and-insights/spotify-first-quarter-earnings-2023/) are engaged with the ad-supported tier of the platform, presenting a big opportunity for advertisers. Spotify’s approach to engaging users is multifaceted, employing a combination of audio, video, and display ads to effectively reach and resonate with audiences. 

By utilizing audio when users are most receptive, complemented by engaging video content to enhance messaging, and reinforced through strategic display ad placements, Spotify maximizes ad impact. The platform’s commitment to innovation is evident through its continual enhancement of ad offerings, introducing new functionalities to ensure advertisers can optimize their campaigns and connect with audiences in meaningful ways.

### **Spotify Provides a First-party Data Advantage**

Whenever a user listens to a song, queues a playlist, or creates their own playlist — they are telegraphing something about themselves:

*   **How they feel**
*   **Where they are**
*   **What they’re doing**

This is the power of [first-party data](https://tinuiti.com/blog/privacy-prep/first-party-data/), and it’s a golden commodity for marketers and brands when it comes to reaching a targeted audience at the right time.

Consider Spotify’s running playlists for example. Spotify collects data that pinpoints when and how often users listen to running playlists. Brands like Nike put ad dollars to insert themselves into the headphones of users who are fired up and exercising. To put it simply – the ad resonates on an even deeper level.

Brands can use Spotify’s first-party data to reach listeners during very specific moods or activities — all based on the music that they’re engaging with.

**Josh Brisco** believes that Spotify’s advertising platform will only become more powerful in the future.

> _“With millions of ad-supported listeners world-wide and robust targeting capabilities, it is a fantastic way to get in front of a desired audience. Its continued user growth and investment in its ad units, capabilities, and overall product make it one to watch.”_
